messages.subject: Pennington v Tregarth - metallurgical report (final)
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

My final report is attached. In short: mean raceway hardness 53.4 HRC against the 60 HRC requirement, classic sub-surface fatigue spalling, microstructure consistent with under-hardening, and the three alternative causes (overload, over-temperature, poor lubrication) excluded as the primary mechanism. Mean life observed ~4,100 hours against the 30,000-hour L10.

Happy to discuss before you settle the pleadings.

Adrian
